title: 第10章 相胸

content_zh:
展步也眉开眼笑：“好，作为一个安分守法的好公民，我一定全力配合你们的工作。”
其实展步知道，两千块钱真的不算少了，一般城市的市民立个二等功三等功，可能奖金都不到二三百块钱，这两千块钱不过是为了让展步把功劳让给乘警而已。
几分钟后，展步几人回到了原来的座位，展步的兜里多了两千块钱，这时候展步心里有些感叹，果然是逢胸化吉，不止救了两个孩子，自己还赚了两千块钱。
经过了此事，几人关系也算拉近了不少，各自做了一个简单的介绍，女孩名叫杨寓筠，那个和女孩一起的年轻人叫叶梁晨，中年大叔姓杜，是一个生意人。
杨寓筠很活泼，坐下来之后脸色依然红彤彤，显然为救了两个小生命而开心不已：“真是太奇妙了，两个婴儿好可爱。”
然后，杨寓筠忽然盯着展步的眼睛：“你是怎么知道那女人有问题的？”
听到杨寓筠这么问，叶梁晨与中年大叔也都不说话，好奇的盯着展步。
展步无辜的摊了摊手：“我说我是算出来的，你们信么？”
杨寓筠翻了个白眼：“切，鬼才信你，我才不信这些鬼啊神啊之类的东西，说实话。”
中年大叔也笑着调侃了一句：“他不是说他是相胸师么，没准真的是看那个妇女看出了点什么，哈哈哈……”
展步听到中年大叔的大笑，知道中年大叔是在调笑他，展步一脸幽怨：“都亲眼见证奇迹了，你们还不相信，我也没办法了。”
中年大叔笑着拍了拍展步的肩膀：“我不是说笑，对了，你的身手是真不错，刚才一下子跳出去的时候，真把我吓着了，一般的武警恐怕也没有你的身手利索吧。”
展步一脸傲然，虽然自己功夫在老道和胖师兄眼里只算三脚猫，但是徒手对付几个地痞流氓也不算大事。至于一般的武警，呵呵，展步也不放在眼里。
他笑了一下说道：“我跟着师傅学过几年功夫。”
听到展步的话，中年大叔一愣：“咱不开玩笑，别说什么相胸不相胸，你不会真懂相术吧？”
展步点了点头：“当然，相胸术就把相面术与风水学结合起来才发展出来的，相面术我自然懂。”
听到展步说自己懂相术，中年大叔还没等说话，杨寓筠就哈哈大笑，夸张的说道：“不是吧大叔，你还真信他啊，你不会是想让他给你算命吧。”
叶梁晨也撇了撇嘴，有些阴阳怪气：“就是啊大叔，这是封建迷信，不可信的。而且人家是相胸师，男人凑不了热闹。”
展步听得出来，杨寓筠虽然不信相术，不过对自己的态度更多的是开玩笑一般，但是叶梁晨却是发自心底的排斥自己。
展步毫不客气的说道：“井底之蛙怎么知道世界之大，相术八卦传承了几千年，没有真正的作用，早就淹没在历史长河之中了。”

叶梁晨反唇相讥：“那是因为古人愚昧，不懂科学。”
展步蔑视的一笑，然后指了指杨寓筠说道：“你倒是用科学解释一下，为什么医生抱着孩子都没用，她抱一下孩子，那孩子就好了？”
“碰巧了而已，医生不是也说，母爱是这个世界上最伟大的奇迹……”
“呵呵，奇迹，好，那你用科学解释一下，什么叫奇迹？”
叶梁晨张了张嘴，哑口无言。
听到展步这么说，杨寓筠来了兴趣：“那你说为什么我抱一下孩子，孩子就好了。”
展步努了努嘴：“说了你也不信。”
这女孩一看就是无神论者，你和她说相术，她大概立刻把你的话当玩笑，所以展步不想多说什么，对相师来说，要开口，首先就要求对方心诚，心不诚，相师不会自讨没趣。
叶梁晨却以为展步根本就是诈他，这些不过是巧合，他说道：“你要是真懂相术，那你倒是算算，我们是做什么的或者我们早饭吃的什么，算对了就算你说的对。”
展步冷冷一笑：“你早上吃的韭菜包子。”
叶梁晨一下子愣住了，他没想到展步竟然一下子就说出了自己的早餐是什么，他惊讶的问道：“你……怎么知道的？”
展步一笑：“你的门牙上还留着一片韭菜叶。”
噗一声，杨寓筠与中年大叔同时笑了出来，叶梁晨脸色一阵红一阵白，咬牙切齿的瞪了一眼展步。

content_en:
Zhan Bu also smiled brightly: "Okay, as a good law-abiding citizen, I will fully cooperate with your work."
In fact, Zhan Bu knows that two thousand yuan is really not a small amount. For citizens in ordinary cities, the bonus may be less than two or three hundred yuan for a second-class or third-class meritorious service. The two thousand yuan is just for Zhan Bu to give the credit to the police.
A few minutes later, Zhan Bu and the others returned to their original seats. Zhan Bu had an extra two thousand yuan in his pocket. At this time, Zhan Bu sighed in his heart. It turned out to be a lucky break. Not only did he save the two children, he also made two thousand yuan.
After this incident, the relationship between the few people became much closer, and they each made a brief introduction. The girl's name was Yang Yuyun, the young man with the girl was named Ye Liangchen, and the middle-aged uncle's surname was Du, and he was a businessman.
Yang Yuyun was very lively, and her face was still red even after sitting down. She was obviously very happy to have saved two little lives: "It's really amazing, the two babies are so cute."
Then, Yang Yuyun suddenly stared into Zhan Bu's eyes: "How did you know there was something wrong with that woman?"
Hearing Yang Yuyun's question, Ye Liangchen and the middle-aged uncle didn't say anything and stared at Zhan Bu curiously.
Zhan Bu spread his hands innocently: "I said I figured it out, do you believe it?"
Yang Yuyun rolled his eyes: "Tsk, only ghosts believe you. I don't believe in these ghosts and gods, to be honest."
The middle-aged uncle also laughed and joked: "Didn't he say that he is a breast physicist? Maybe he really saw something from that woman, hahaha..."
Zhan Bu heard the middle-aged uncle's laughter and knew that the middle-aged uncle was teasing him. Zhan Bu looked resentful: "I have witnessed the miracle with my own eyes, and you still don't believe it. There is nothing I can do."
The middle-aged uncle smiled and patted Zhan Bu on the shoulder: "I'm not joking. By the way, your skills are really good. When you jumped out just now, you really scared me. I'm afraid ordinary armed police officers are not as agile as you."
Zhan Bu looked arrogant. Although his kung fu was only a three-legged cat in the eyes of the old Taoist and fat senior brother, it was not a big deal to deal with a few ruffians with his bare hands. As for ordinary armed police, hehe, Zhan Bu doesn’t take them seriously either.
He smiled and said, "I have learned kung fu from my master for several years."
Hearing Zhan Bu's words, the middle-aged uncle was startled: "We're not kidding, don't talk about whether you are in love with your breasts or not, you don't really know the art of physiognomy, do you?"
Zhan Bu nodded: "Of course, the art of physiognomy is developed by combining physiognomy with Feng Shui. I naturally understand physiognomy."
Hearing Zhan Bu say that he knew physiognomy, before the middle-aged uncle could say anything, Yang Yuyun laughed loudly and said exaggeratedly: "No, uncle, you really believe him. You don't want him to tell your fortune."
Ye Liangchen also curled his lips and said with a bit of yin and yang: "That's right, uncle, this is feudal superstition and cannot be trusted. Besides, he is a breast physicist, so men can't join in the fun."
Zhan Bu could tell that although Yang Yuyun didn't believe in fortune telling, his attitude toward him was more of a joke, but Ye Liangchen rejected him from the bottom of his heart.
Zhan Bu said unceremoniously: "How does a frog at the bottom of a well know how big the world is? The art of physiognomy and gossip has been passed down for thousands of years. It has no real effect and has long been submerged in the long river of history."
Ye Liangchen retorted: "That's because the ancients were ignorant and didn't understand science."
Zhan Bu smiled contemptuously, then pointed at Yang Yuyun and said, "Can you explain scientifically why it is useless for the doctor to hold the child, but if she holds the child, the child will be fine?"
"It's just a coincidence. Didn't the doctor also say that maternal love is the greatest miracle in the world..."
"Haha, miracle, okay, then you can explain it scientifically, what is a miracle?"
Ye Liangchen opened his mouth and was speechless.
Hearing what Zhan Bu said, Yang Yuyun became interested: "Then why do you sayIf I hold the child, the child will be fine. "
Zhan Bu pursed his lips and said, "You wouldn't believe it even if I told you. "
This girl is an atheist at first glance. If you talk to her about fortune telling, she will probably immediately take your words as a joke, so Zhan Bu doesn’t want to say anything more. For a fortune teller, before you want to speak, you must first ask the other party to be sincere. If you are not sincere, the fortune teller will not ask for trouble.
Ye Liangchen thought that Zhan Bu was simply deceiving him and that these were just coincidences. He said: "If you really know physiognomy, then you can calculate what we do or what we eat for breakfast. If you calculate it correctly, you will be right. "
Zhan Bu smiled coldly: "The leek buns you ate in the morning. "
Ye Liangchen was stunned for a moment. He didn't expect Zhan Bu to tell him what his breakfast was all at once. He asked in surprise: "How... did you know? "
Zhan Bu smiled: "You still have a leek leaf on your front tooth. "
With a pop, Yang Yuyun and the middle-aged uncle laughed at the same time. Ye Liangchen's face turned red and white, and he gritted his teeth and glared at Zhan Bu.
